candidates.term: The Rival at the Month Gate
candidates.defline: At your Month Gate stands the daring colleague: the working world sees your nerve first.
candidates.reading: This position rules Career and Social. Professionally you read as the one who will make the call others are still pricing: bold in negotiation, quick to bet on yourself, magnetic in a team and expensive to compete with. Careers with real stakes suit you, sales floors, launches, turnarounds. Steady ladders bore you into mischief. Pick arenas where daring is the job description, and keep one cautious friend close for the days nerve needs a brake.
candidates.teaser: At work you compete the way others breathe, and people feel it. Your career rises fastest in open contests, and slowest wherever the prize must be split.
